name: How To Follow Jesus
overview: Following Jesus requires entering through the narrow gate, recognizing that the broad way leads to destruction as Jesus teaches in Matthew 7:13. He declares Himself to be the only way to the Father, emphasizing that no one comes to God except through Him (John 14:6). Since all have sinned and fall short of God's glory (Romans 3:23), the law serves as a guide to bring us to Christ, where justification is received through faith (Galatians 3:24). Thus, true discipleship is grounded in faith in Jesus as the exclusive path to salvation.
